annotations.title: Record an opt-out request from the called party

description: Call this when the called party asks to stop receiving calls (by voice or key press). scope "caller" stops calls from this caller; scope "all" records that they asked to stop AI assistant calls from all participating callers. Honour it within ten business days.

country.description: ISO country code, only needed when the number is in national format (US, CA, AU, NZ, GB, IE)

number.description: Phone number of the party who asked to stop calls, E.164 preferred (+15125550100)

scope.description: "caller" = stop calls from this caller only; "all" = stop AI assistant calls from every participating caller

name: record_opt_out
title: Record an opt-out request from the called party
